name: 98686 · Vancouver, WA
findings: ZIP 98686 (Vancouver) has 54 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98686 (Vancouver) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 98686 (Vancouver) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 39% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
